_doc: Tanks, the drive, the gun and the station energy models (brief 2.2, 2.4). Owner: rules. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_tanks. Units: art px, game metres, seconds, joules of P_eff, % FTP. G1 tuning against the brief (balance probe, TankRig sessions of every crew; details in docs/decisions/tank.md): hull.hp 120 (brief 100), dynamo.stabilizer_per_s 2.0 (1.5), steam.full_j 4500 (6000), gearbox.hoist_j 3500 (4000), gearbox.auto_drive_clear_px 340 (300: a medium holds up to 340 px, so 300 left it unengaged). G2 balance iteration 1 (docs/decisions/tank.md Balance iteration 1): Bulwark enemy_scale 0.75 (0.6), hull.hp 140 (100), hull.checkpoint_hp 30 (20), drive.evasive_hit_mult 0.5 (0.7), dynamo.stabilizer_per_s back to the brief 1.5, dynamo.hoist_s [22, 11] ([20, 10]), gearbox.hoist_j back to the brief 4000. v2 contracts (docs/decisions/tank.md 2026-10-27 v2 contract): the Bastion (crew 4); the Citadel's rooms in the reference's order rear to front (diesel, steam, dynamo; the slot-to-engine map is stations.json start_engines) and only its main turret (bow guns replace the secondaries); the Bastion's hull_px from assets/tank/v2/kit.json in rules px (art px / 1.5, rounded): width tank.variants.tank_4rider.hull_length_px 491 / 1.5 = 327, height 71 = (road_wheel_line.ground_contact_y 233 - the hull roof row 127 of hull_3rider.png) / 1.5 (one vertical framing for every variant); the kit's sizes for the other tanks (Bulwark [220, 71], Rampart [251, 71], Citadel [296, 71]) wait for the v2 view, since the v1 view and its rigs.json are built on [192, 72], [240, 76] and [288, 80]; power_ratio: the target % FTP of SIM phases without an ERG target (TankRules.target_pct). Added keys: props (obstacle sizes, light_hits_to_clear, standoff_px: a barricade stops the tank this far short because the gun cannot depress onto anything nearer than about 230 px), drill.wreck_px (the aim drill's wrecks, px ahead of the halted hull). v2 rules (P4, docs/decisions/tank.md 2026-10-27 P4 rules ADR): the ram block is gone (evade: sprint_window_s, hold_s, boss_hold_s); bow (the bow guns on every tank) replaces secondary and dynamo.per_secondary / secondary_min_bank; arc.lit_dispersion_mult; gun.elev_min_deg -12 (the brief); hull_px from the kit for every tank; the Rampart's and the Bastion's own stabilizer_per_s (1.3 and 2.0; dynamo.stabilizer_per_s 1.5 for the rest). Retuned on the v2 geometry and the bow guns (each within +-50% of the brief): hull.hp 150 (brief 100, the bound), drive.evasive_hit_mult 0.45 (0.7), props.standoff_px 180 (the main gun and the bow guns reach a barricade there), steam.full_j 4000 (6000), steam.breech_cycle_s 7 (6: the boiler's 0 lands up to 1 s after a latch, and with -12 degrees the gun often fires at once, so 7 keeps T3's 6 s at grade 0), gearbox.hoist_j 5250 (4000), dynamo.hoist_s [24, 12] ([20, 10]). Integration polish (2026-10-27): dynamo.hoist_s [22, 11] (the Rampart's hoist; brief [20, 10]). v3 contracts (2026-10-28, docs/decisions/tank.md v3 contracts ADR): one tank, the landship (code 5, crew 1-4, five seats rear to front: diesel, steam, dynamo, arc, feed), with its hull_px and geometry from the r6 hitbox in rules px; the Bulwark, Rampart, Citadel and Bastion (codes 1-4 reserved) and the Bulwark gearbox block are retired; enemy_scale 1.0 for every crew (HP the same for every crew size; v3 scales enemy counts by crew size instead: enemies.json crew_count_scale). v3 rules (2026-10-28, docs/decisions/tank.md v3 rules ADR): the dynamo hoist is gone (an empty Loader seat means no reloads); steam is the Loader's ready rack (full_j 1750 J of P_eff in band a shell, about 7 s at 250 W; rack_start 3 shells in the rack at the start; chamber_s 1 s to chamber the next round at gun.load_elev_deg; breech_cycle_s retired); bow is the Secondaries seat's rounds (2 per pedal revolution: damage per round, slew_deg_s [under band, in band], aim_tol_deg, clear_rounds for a barricade); arc is the Lights seat (lit: the gun's full range and dispersion; dark: dark_range_px from the hull's front, dispersion x dark_dispersion_mult). Retuned on the v3 sims (docs/decisions/tank.md v3 rules ADR): damage light 14 / heavy 35 / over 70 (20 / 50 / 100 x 0.7: the Loader's rack makes shells about 2.3x faster than v2's boiler, so fights last long enough for telegraphs, the bank and the searchlight load, while a crew of 2, whose second rider shares the Gun and the Loader, still clears every Advance in time); dynamo.stabilizer_per_s 2.25 (1.5, the brief's +50% bound: v2's bow bursts also drained the bank, about 1 unit a second, and the bow guns are the Secondaries' now); steam.over_j 1300 (3000: 75% of a shell's full_j, v2's ratio 3000 / 4000). v3 solo balance: steam.checkpoint_rack_by_crew [3, 0, 0, 0] (a solo rider's rack is restocked at each checkpoint; crews load their own).

landship._doc: v3 (brief 'One tank, five seats'): the one tank every crew size (1-4) rides, the reference landship rebuilt as pixel art (r6). engines: its five seats rear to front as the art has them (Drive diesel, Loader steam, Gun dynamo, Lights arc, Secondaries feed); crew: [smallest, largest]. hull_px and geometry are rules px (art px / 1.5) in the hull frame: x from the hull's rear (art x 14, the r6 hull rect's rear edge), y down from art y 111.5 so the hull's bottom row (the track run's ground contact, art y 209) is y hull_px[1] = 65; negative y lies above the hull rect (the turret). Source: assets/tank/v3/r6_hitbox.json (the mockup's collision data, sprite 475 x 216 art px facing right) and the r6 room rects (assets/tank/v3/tools_src/tank_r5.gd layout, which r6 keeps). The gun invariant: muzzle == trunnion + [barrel_px, 0] at 0 degrees (TankGeometry.validate).
landship.label: TANK_TANK_LANDSHIP

evade._doc: Surge to evade (brief 2.4): a telegraphed shot misses when a rider who can evade (a SIM WORK phase of their own plan, past its first 300 s) holds the sprint rule (the trailing sprint_window_s average >= 1.2 x FTP raw, BRIEF 3.5) for hold_s inside the telegraph, boss_hold_s for the Behemoth's main gun. v1's ram block, reduced to what evade needs.

power_ratio._doc: TankRiderState.target_pct where no ERG target applies (brief 2.3 In band): the diesel and the Bulwark use the middle of in_band.sim_ftp_pct, the building steam engine TankConst.STEAM_BUILD_PCT; these are the rest.

steam._doc: v3 (brief 'Combat changes'): the Loader in band (or on reserve) fills the ready rack, one shell per full_j joules of P_eff (pressure 0..100% is the shell's progress); at 100% the shell is stowed (a heavy, or a light shell latched from light_latch_pct); with window_s the rider may surge (`over`) within it to take the shell just stowed back to the boiler and overpressure it (100 -> over_max_pct on over_j while the sprint rule holds; bleeds over_bleed_pct_s otherwise; a heavy again after over_max_s), the double-damage Overpressure shell. The Gun fires the chambered round and chambers the next in chamber_s at gun.load_elev_deg.

bow._doc: v3: the Secondaries seat (feed): two bow guns, 2 rounds per pedal revolution of its rider (alternating guns) at the nearest near threat (v4: recon, tankette) whose near edge is min_px..max_px off the hull front, else a wire or wreck barricade there (clear_rounds rounds clear it). damage per round (armour: enemies.json light_mult). The guns slew at slew_deg_s [under band, in band] (power in band sets their speed); a round hits when the gun points within aim_tol_deg of the target, else it misses.

arc._doc: v3: the Lights seat (arc generator). While its rider is in band the searchlights are lit: the main gun reaches its full range with its normal dispersion. Empty or not lit, far targets only up to dark_range_m, with its dispersion x dark_dispersion_mult (dark_range_px is v3's, until the Autopilot moves).

repair._doc: v4: the Repairs seat rebuilds hp_per_kj hull HP per kJ of P_eff in band (x difficulty.repair), one patch per patch_hp.
